thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT -> page fired: Incident #84321 for tenant=thalassa-pay (DEDICATED). Symptoms: p95 latency 4.2s, 5xx spike 3.6% over last 5m. Grafana: https://metrics.redwood/inspect/84321 :rotating_light:

samir: acking — oncall here (sam). grabbing runbook and looking into metrics.

pagerduty: Incident 84321 acknowledged by sam@oncall. Escalation policy: SRE -> infra if not acked in 5m.

sam: quick sanity: checking KV cache hitrate and reserved pool metrics.

kai: observed kvcache_hit dropped from ~98% to ~62% starting 2965431800, coincident with p95 bump. Also seeing fallback to disk logs.

julia: I'm infra oncall, jumping in. checking reserved capacity and autoscaler.

sam: running diagnostic commands now:
```
# check reserved pool status
rwdctl reserved status --tenant thalassa-pay 
# tail pod logs for kvcache fallback
kubectl -n inference logs -l tenant=thalassa-pay -c runtime --since=10m | grep -i "kv cache miss" | tail -n 20
```

kai: log excerpt:
```
2026-03-15T14:16:11Z runtime[pid=4221] WARN kv_cache: miss -> fallback_to_disk key=ctx-9fe...
2026-03-15T14:16:12Z runtime[pid=4221] WARN queue: burst_queue_len=78, target=16
2026-03-15T14:16:13Z runtime[pid=4221] ERROR forwarder: downstream 504 for route model-v1
```

julia: autoscaler looks stuck on a couple of nodes — API returns scaling in progress but new instances not joining the pool. I'm checking node provisioning logs.

ops-lead: Proactive idea: temporarily reduce per-tenant max concurrency and enable burst-burst fallback to other region/model variant to reduce immediate pressure. cc @marco for customer comms.

sam: executing a controlled scale and a routing shift:
```
# scale up reserved pool by 2 GPUs
rwdctl reserved scale --tenant thalassa-pay --delta 2 --reason "p95 spike + kvcache fallback"
# route 25% traffic to eu-west-1 variant
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" 
  https://api.redwood/v1/routing/tenants/thalassa-pay/config 
  -d '{"rules":[{"match":"*","route":"eu-west-1","percent":25}]}'
```

sam: rwdctl returned: 202 Accepted, scale job id=scale-981. routing API returned 200.

kai: seeing immediate improvement: 5xx down from 3.6% -> 1.1% in the last 90s. p95 down to ~1.8s. KV cache hitrate slowly recovering.

julia: infra found provisioning failure — cloud provider rate-limited instance create calls. I opened support ticket and kicked a manual retry, nodes are joining now.

marco: Customer Success loop: sending heads-up email to Thalassa Pay with RCA-in-progress note and mitigation steps. Template snippet sent to #customer-success for review.

ops-lead: good triage. recommend keeping routing in place for 30m and then gradually roll back once p95 stable under 800ms for 10m.

sam: agreed. I'll keep watching and will handoff at 14:25 UTC to julia if stable.

julia: taking over active watch. I'll close PD once we've held SLO for 15m and nodes fully healthy.

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: Incident 84321 escalated to SRE-LEAD at 2965432280.

kai: metrics at 14:22:
- p95: 790ms
- 5xx: 0.7%
- kv_cache_hit: 93%

sam: nice. leaving the call but available if needed. handing off to julia (oncall). :white_check_mark:

julia: acknowledged handoff, continuing monitoring and will close PD when stable and routing removed.

julia: PD incident 84321 closed at 2965432415 after 18m of monitoring. Root cause: cloud API rate-limit causing delayed node join -> transient kvcache misses & burst queue saturations. Mitigation: manual scale retry + short-term routing to eu-west-1. Follow-up: infra to request higher provisioning quota and add retry backoff to autoscaler.

incident-bot: Note: follow-up ticket created INFRA-562 for quota + autoscaler retry improvements.

marco: thx all, I'll send the customer a summary and link to INFRA-562.

sam: good job team. :tada:
